text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of summer camp,
and Mejiro
McQueen and I are training
on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Why don't we take a break to
rehydrate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hep... Hahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Your serve is too fast! This is

impossible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh, one point for me! At this rate,
I'm gonna
win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that... Ryan and Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They're playing beach volleyball. That
looks fun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What, really?! Are you interested too,
McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(Ines Fujin—a caring Umamusume who
perfectly
fits the role of everyone's big
sister.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Ines! Did you come here with
them?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was thinking I'd challenge Ryan
in the
next game, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, why don't you join
and make it
a doubles match?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Some beach volleyball does seem useful
to help
strengthen my legs and core...
All right, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would be happy to join. Trainer, I'll be
back
soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Dober vs
Mejiro
Ryan and Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An intense battle between the two pairs
begins!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gah! McQueen, the ball!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ahh! I won't make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! We got another point!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, you're really something! You've
scored so
many points all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scorching summer sun beats down
on them as
the battle continues...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... This is getting tougher by the second.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the heat is wearing me out quicker
than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the posture volleyball
requires
makes it all the more taxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Yeah, it's definitely tiring... but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is precisely what gets me pumped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: After all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Working out is always my goal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: POW!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Another point for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What?! I can't believe you still have
energy to
spend in these conditions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They continue to play until the sun
finally sets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That was difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I should have known better than to
play a
ball game against Ryan.
choice_data_list: That was one fierce battle, wasn't...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, where on earth does she get that

competitive strength from?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, where on earth does she get that

competitive strength from?
choice_data_list: Isn't it all about guts after all?
I think it's all about guts after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Her physical strength? Hmm...
choice_data_list: Isn't it all about guts after all?
I think it's all about guts after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's weight training certainly goes
beyond the
norm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But if that's true, wouldn't some more
time in the
gym help me improve my
competitive strength as
well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's certainly worth a try.
Let's start
first thing
tomorrow!
choice_data_list: Want to ramp up the strength training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I add more weight training
to
Mejiro McQueen's regimen, as she
requested.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-willpower...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see. Yes, that's what it all comes down
to, isn't
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...All right, in that case,
I shall learn from
her
example and try to improve my own
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That said,
I'm not sure how I should start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! It's true that would likely
strengthen
my fortitude, but...
choice_data_list: Want to start with a total ban on ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please, allow me some time to think!
